summary.title: Arm Architecture Reference Manual for A-profile architecture (DDI 0487)
summary.one_liner: The official Arm A-profile architecture specification (Armv8-A and Armv9-A), available as a PDF and an early-access HTML preview, with machine-readable ASL and concurrency-model packages.
takeaways: DDI 0487 is the normative definition of the Armv8-A and Armv9-A processing element (PE) operation.
The HTML version is an early access preview; the PDF is the authoritative reference if they differ.
Machine-readable XML/HTML feature, register and instruction descriptions accompany the manual, along with ASL and concurrency model sources.
The release history runs from the 2013 beta through the Armv9.6 EAC release (version M.d, 30 Sep 2026).
summary.summary: This page is the landing page for Arm's Architecture Reference Manual for A-profile architecture (document ARM DDI 0487, version M.d, EAC quality, non-confidential). It describes the Armv8 and Armv9 architectures and the operation of Armv8-A and Armv9-A processing elements. The page lists companion packages: machine-readable feature, register and instruction descriptions, the ASL language definition and reference tools, and the cat memory model with the herdtools7 concurrency model ecosystem. It also includes a release table from 2013 to 2026 and the legal notices. The page text here does not itself detail NEON or SVE content; that comes from the listing's description of the manual.
